capabilities: Generate learning cards from notes with AI assistance
Study flashcards, multiple-choice questions, cloze blanks, and short answers
Schedule reviews with an FSRS-style spaced repetition workflow
Filter review sessions by current note, folder, or date range
Track progress in a local learning dashboard
extras: Privacy section states that selected note content is sent only to user-configured AI providers, API keys are stored locally, and no telemetry is collected. Available on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn existing notes into study cards or run spaced-repetition review sessions over them.

requires.name: AI provider keys for card generation

summary: Learning-card plugin that generates AI-assisted flashcards, quizzes, and cloze blanks from notes and schedules spaced-repetition review sessions.
